split_policy: disjoint procedural map seeds across train, val, test; no row-wise split
observation_time: all input columns are measured before env.step()
quality_filter: clean/ contains only successful, quality-approved episodes and samples with verified action and no raw out-of-range spikes
known_limitations: Privileged geometry inputs are read directly from the simulator
No demonstration of generalization until a trained model is independently evaluated on held-out seeds
Applied action verification on user's installed MetaDrive 0.4.3 is required
